name: Party Host
ability: You start knowing 3 players, exactly 1 of whom is evil.
flavor: Three guests arrived together. One of them didn't bring anything.
firstNightReminder: Point to 3 players, exactly 1 of whom is evil. Mark them GUEST.

name: Candy Bowl
ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): they are sober and healthy until dusk tomorrow.
flavor: Take one. Okay, take two. Nobody is checking.
firstNightReminder: The Candy Bowl chooses a player: mark them TREAT.
otherNightReminder: The Candy Bowl chooses a player: mark them TREAT.

name: Ouija Board
ability: Each night, choose a dead player: they point at a living player. You learn if that player is evil.
flavor: Nobody is moving it. Everybody is moving it.
firstNightReminder: The Ouija Board points at a dead player. Wake that dead player: they point at a living player. Put them to sleep. Tell the Ouija Board if that player is evil (thumbs down) or not (thumbs up).
otherNightReminder: The Ouija Board points at a dead player. Wake that dead player: they point at a living player. Put them to sleep. Tell the Ouija Board if that player is evil (thumbs down) or not (thumbs up).

name: Corn Maze
ability: Each night, you learn whether the Demon is closer to you clockwise, closer anticlockwise, or equally close.
flavor: Keep your left hand on the wall. Or was it the right?
firstNightReminder: Point clockwise or anticlockwise toward the nearer Demon, or point straight up if they are equally close.
otherNightReminder: Point clockwise or anticlockwise toward the nearer Demon, or point straight up if they are equally close.

name: Trick-or-Treater
ability: Each night, choose a player you haven't chosen before: you learn "treat" if they are a Townsfolk, or "trick" if not. [+0 to +2 Trick-or-Treater]
flavor: Third house on the left gives out full-size bars. Fourth house gives out pennies. Never go to the fourth house.
firstNightReminder: The Trick-or-Treater chooses a player not yet marked CHOSEN: mark them CHOSEN. Nod for treat (a Townsfolk), shake your head for trick (anything else).
otherNightReminder: The Trick-or-Treater chooses a player not yet marked CHOSEN: mark them CHOSEN. Nod for treat (a Townsfolk), shake your head for trick (anything else).

name: Doorbell
ability: Each night*, you learn how many players chose you tonight.
flavor: Ding dong. Ding dong. Ding dong. Nobody there.
otherNightReminder: Show the Doorbell how many players chose them tonight.

name: Bat
ability: Each night*, you learn how many of your living neighbours woke tonight.
flavor: It can't see a thing. It heard you, though.
otherNightReminder: Show the Bat how many of their living neighbours woke tonight (0, 1 or 2).

name: Monster Hunter
ability: Once per game, at night*, choose a player: if they are evil, they die. If they are good, you die.
flavor: Silver, garlic, holy water, a wooden stake and a strong opinion about which neighbour it is.
otherNightReminder: The Monster Hunter may choose a player. If evil, they die; if good, the Monster Hunter dies. Mark NO ABILITY.

name: Monster
ability: If a good player is executed, you may become their character.
flavor: Stitched together from whatever the village threw away. Today, that was a Doorbell.
otherNightReminder: If a good player was executed today, wake the Monster: they may become that character. If they nod, swap the Monster token for that character and show it to them.

name: Jack-o'-Lantern
ability: If the Demon attacks one of your living neighbours, you die instead.
flavor: Carved to keep the spirits off the porch. Nobody said it would survive the night.

name: Black Cat
ability: If an evil player nominates you, they are poisoned until dusk tomorrow.
flavor: Crossed your path, did it? That was a choice you made.

name: Scarecrow
ability: Minions can't choose you or your living neighbours at night.
flavor: It has never once caught a crow. It has, however, frightened several Minions.

name: Skeleton
ability: The 1st night after you die, choose 3 players: you learn if one of them is the Demon.
flavor: Dying was the easy part. Climbing back out took all night.
otherNightReminder: If the Skeleton died since last night, wake them: they choose 3 players. Nod if one of them is the Demon. Mark RISEN.

name: Werewolf
ability: On night 3, you turn evil. You learn who the Demon is, and they learn who you are.
flavor: Perfectly lovely for two nights a month. Please plan accordingly.
otherNightReminder: If it is night 3, wake the Werewolf: show the YOU ARE token and thumbs down, then point to the Demon. Wake the Demon and point to the Werewolf. Mark EVIL.

name: Ghost
ability: You start the game dead.
flavor: Just a sheet with eyeholes. Probably.

name: Rotten Pumpkin
ability: If you die, a living good neighbour of yours is poisoned for the rest of the game.
flavor: It was a fine pumpkin on the first of October.

name: Haunted House
ability: If a Townsfolk chooses you at night, they are drunk until dusk.
flavor: The previous owners left in a hurry. They left the curtains, the piano and the screaming.

name: Torchbearer
ability: Each night, choose a player: tomorrow, votes to execute them count twice.
flavor: Every mob needs someone to light the first torch.
firstNightReminder: The Torchbearer chooses a player: mark them TORCH.
otherNightReminder: The Torchbearer chooses a player: mark them TORCH.

name: Costume Maker
ability: Each night, choose a player: until dusk, they register as any character and alignment of your choice.
flavor: One mask for the party. One mask for the morning after.
firstNightReminder: The Costume Maker chooses a player and a character and alignment: mark them COSTUME.
otherNightReminder: The Costume Maker chooses a player and a character and alignment: mark them COSTUME.

name: Bad Apple
ability: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned tonight and tomorrow. If they are a Townsfolk, you learn their character.
flavor: Looks like a treat. Always check your candy.
firstNightReminder: The Bad Apple chooses a player: mark them POISONED. If they are a Townsfolk, show the Bad Apple their character token.
otherNightReminder: The Bad Apple chooses a player: mark them POISONED. If they are a Townsfolk, show the Bad Apple their character token.

name: Grave Robber
ability: Each night*, choose a dead player: tonight, you have their ability.
flavor: The dead don't need it. That's the whole argument.
otherNightReminder: The Grave Robber chooses a dead player: mark them STOLEN. The Grave Robber has that player's ability tonight.

name: Vampire
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Once per game, they turn evil instead, and learn who you are. [+Monster Hunter]
flavor: Invite him in once. That's all it takes.
otherNightReminder: The Vampire chooses a player and may choose to bite. Bite: they turn evil instead; wake them, show thumbs down and point to the Vampire; mark NO BITE. Otherwise they die.

name: Headless Horseman
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Each time you kill a Townsfolk, you take their head: you register as their character. [-1 Outsider]
flavor: He's been looking for a head that fits for two hundred years.
otherNightReminder: The Headless Horseman chooses a player: they die. If they were a Townsfolk, mark them HEAD: the Headless Horseman now registers as that character.

name: Babysitter
ability: Each night*, choose a player: if they die tonight, you die instead.
flavor: The phone has been ringing for an hour. It's coming from inside the house.
otherNightReminder: The Babysitter chooses a player: mark them WATCHED. If they would die tonight, the Babysitter dies instead.
